name: revetly-launch-video
description: Revetly Launch-Video (Remotion). Eigenständig, unabhängig von der App.

scripts.studio: pnpm audio && pnpm showreel:audio && remotion studio
scripts.stills: pnpm audio && pnpm check && node --no-warnings scripts/stills.mjs
scripts.render: pnpm audio && pnpm check && remotion render RevetlyDemo out/revetly-demo-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:launch: pnpm audio && pnpm check && remotion render Launch-16x9 out/revetly-launch-16x9.mp4 && remotion render Launch-1x1 out/revetly-launch-1x1.mp4
scripts.showreel:assets: NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node scripts/capture-anim.mjs && python3 scripts/showreel_prep.py
scripts.showreel:sheet: pnpm showreel:audio && node --no-warnings scripts/stills.mjs Showreel && python3 scripts/contact-sheet.py
scripts.render:showreel: pnpm showreel:audio && remotion render Showreel-9x16 out/revetly-showreel-9x16.mp4 && remotion render Showreel-1x1 out/revetly-showreel-1x1.mp4 && remotion render Showreel-16x9 out/revetly-showreel-16x9.mp4
